literal_values.message_phrase: NEW MESSAGES ON HIS VOICE MAIL AT HIS OLD LAW FIRM
literal_values.access_phrase: HIS OLD SECRETARY WOULD PROVIDE ACCESS TO THESE CALLS TO THE FBI

observations.reading: The source reports a prospective access opportunity, not actual delivery or acquired audio. The Event paragraph mentions Barbara Olson/Flight77 as context but does not identify who left the new messages, when each was left, content or carrier.
observations.distinction: Do not turn new messages into messages from Barbara Olson, an additional confirmed flight call, a voice identification or a carrier/session match.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original source/contact interview and context, message/event/caller metadata and source-to-message identification, actual access/receipt/collection/custody and disposition.

observations.distinction: Mail and voice mail remain distinct literal descriptions; do not decide whether mail means voicemail, email, physical mail or shorthand. observations.missing_discriminator: Native task/context/attachments and actual contact/response/access/collection/receipt/examination/disposition, including clarification of the requested medium and role relationship.
